description:
Return the engineering-ready per-component accessibility checklist. Each item is tagged by how it is verified (auto / auto+manual / manual / design) and which Required Gate it rolls up to, so a team can work top-to-bottom while building a component.

Use this at the start of building a component, and to see which checklist items a given gate depends on.

Args:
  - section ('A'|'B'|'C'|'D', optional): restrict to one section.
  - response_format ('markdown'|'json'): default 'markdown'.

Returns (json): [{ id, name, items: [{ id, text, method, ruleIds, gate }] }].

section.description: Restrict to one section: A discovery/design, B contract, C implementation, D automated validation, E interaction test coverage, F manual validation, COG cognitive review, G documentation/supportability, H final release gate.

name: a11y_checklist
title: Get the implementation checklist
